en: A vintage black‑and‑white portrait of a woman in traditional Tehuantepec dress. She stands facing the camera, wearing a dark short‑sleeved blouse, a patterned long skirt with lace at the bottom, necklaces, and a large decorative headdress or fan behind her head. To the right is an ornate stand holding what appears to be a stack of bread or pastries. In the background is an architectural backdrop with arches. Handwritten text at the bottom reads "71: Mujer de Tehuantepec." and a small printed code appears in the lower right corner.
